cues.en: In the last video, we discussed the overall system architecture.
cues.zh: 上一支影片介紹了整體系統架構。

cues.en: In this one, we're going to be discussing the machine learning pipeline architecture.
cues.zh: 這支影片要討論機器學習管線架構。

cues.en: Our banking API is going to integrate a machine learning pipeline designed to detect fraudulent transactions in real time.
cues.zh: 銀行 API 會整合一條機器學習管線，用來即時偵測詐欺交易。

cues.en: This pipeline will replace a rule based approach that we shall also implement, so that we have an adaptive and data driven solution that continuously improves over time.
cues.zh: 這條管線將取代我們也會實作的規則式方法，提供能隨時間持續改善、具適應能力且由資料驅動的解決方案。

cues.en: Let me walk you through the components and the flow.
cues.zh: 我帶你看各個元件與流程。

cues.en: First we're going to have the data collection and processing.
cues.zh: 首先是資料收集與處理。

cues.en: Our pipeline begins with collecting transaction user and account data.
cues.zh: 管線會先收集交易、使用者與帳戶資料。

cues.en: The transaction data is going to be the raw transaction information including amounts, timestamps,
cues.zh: 交易資料就是原始交易資訊，包括金額、時間戳記，

cues.en: types, etc. the user data is going to include the customer profile information, transaction history and the behavioral patterns.
cues.zh: 交易類型等。使用者資料包括客戶個人資料、交易歷史與行為模式。

cues.en: And then the account history is going to be historical account activities such as balance changes and usage patterns.
cues.zh: 帳戶歷史則是過去的帳戶活動，例如餘額變化與使用模式。

cues.en: Then the data collected is going to be fed to a feature extractor.
cues.zh: 收集到的資料會送進特徵擷取器。

cues.en: This is going to be the central component that processes raw data and extracts meaningful features.
cues.zh: 這是核心元件，處理原始資料並擷取有意義的特徵。

cues.en: Then the extracted data from the previous step is going to be processed through feature engineering so that we can extract meaningful patterns.
cues.zh: 接著，前一步擷取的資料會經過特徵工程，找出有意義的模式。

cues.en: These patterns are going to include time features, which basically extracts time based patterns such as the hour of the day, the day of the week, etc. that may indicate suspicious activity.
cues.zh: 其中包括時間特徵，擷取一天中的時刻、星期幾等時間模式，這些可能顯示可疑活動。

cues.en: Then the metadata features this is going to extract information from transaction metadata such as currency conversion rates, etc. then we have the account features.
cues.zh: 接著是中繼資料特徵，從交易中繼資料擷取資訊，例如匯率等。再來是帳戶特徵。

cues.en: These are features related to the account age, balance and status.
cues.zh: 這些特徵與帳戶成立時間、餘額及狀態有關。

cues.en: Then we have the user history features.
cues.zh: 接著是使用者歷史特徵。

cues.en: These are patterns from the user's previous transaction behavior.
cues.zh: 也就是使用者過往交易行為中的模式。

cues.en: And then we're going to have the velocity features.
cues.zh: 再來是交易速率特徵。

cues.en: These are going to be features tracking transaction frequency and volume over different time windows.
cues.zh: 它們會追蹤不同時間範圍內的交易頻率與交易量。

cues.en: Then all these features are going to be piped through a data preparation service.
cues.zh: 所有特徵接著會送進資料準備服務。

cues.en: This service is going to combine all the features into a clean data set ready for model training.
cues.zh: 這個服務將所有特徵整合成乾淨的資料集，準備用於模型訓練。

cues.en: So you can proceed to the model training part.
cues.zh: 接著就能進入模型訓練部分。

cues.en: The features that we have extracted are going to be used to train a gradient boosting classifier.
cues.zh: 我們會用擷取的特徵，訓練梯度提升分類器。

cues.en: We shall be using gradient boosting as it's the classifier for the fraud detection system that we are building.
cues.zh: 我們正在打造的詐欺偵測系統，會使用梯度提升作為分類器。

cues.en: In our model training, we're going to first train or test split.
cues.zh: 模型訓練時，先進行訓練集與測試集切分。

cues.en: This is the process of dividing the data into training and testing sets.
cues.zh: 這是將資料分成訓練集與測試集的過程。

cues.en: Then you're going to pass the data to the model trainer.
cues.zh: 再將資料傳給模型訓練器。

cues.en: And the model trainer is going to orchestrate the training process.
cues.zh: 模型訓練器會統籌訓練流程。

cues.en: Then you're going to pass the data through the gradient boosting classifier.
cues.zh: 接著讓資料通過梯度提升分類器。

cues.en: This is going to be the core machine learning algorithm that you're going to be using for the fraud detection.
cues.zh: 這是我們會用於詐欺偵測的核心機器學習演算法。

cues.en: Through this model we shall identify which features are most significant for prediction.
cues.zh: 透過這個模型，我們可以找出對預測最重要的特徵。

cues.en: That's why we have this feature importance part.
cues.zh: 所以這裡會有特徵重要性這一部分。

cues.en: And then we're also going to have the output of our trained model.
cues.zh: 接著也會有訓練完成的模型輸出。

cues.en: This is going to be the output model that is ready for evaluation.
cues.zh: 輸出的模型已準備好進行評估。

cues.en: Then move to the model evaluation stage.
cues.zh: 然後進入模型評估階段。

cues.en: In the model evaluation stage the trained model is going to be evaluated using multiple metrics to assess performance.
cues.zh: 在這一階段，會使用多個指標評估訓練完成的模型，衡量其效能。

cues.en: The metrics are going to be one the AUC score which is the area under the ROC curve which is a key metric for fraud detection models.
cues.zh: 第一個指標是 AUC 分數，也就是 ROC 曲線下面積，是詐欺偵測模型的重要指標。

cues.en: Then precision precision is going to measure the accuracy of positive predictions.
cues.zh: 接著是精確率，衡量陽性預測的正確程度。

cues.en: Then we have recall which is going to measure the ability to find all the fraud cases, then we're going to have the F1 score, which is going to be the harmonic mean of precision and recall.
cues.zh: 還有召回率，衡量找出所有詐欺案例的能力。接著是 F1 分數，也就是精確率與召回率的調和平均。

cues.en: These two then you're going to have the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 就是這兩個。接著還有混淆矩陣。

cues.en: This is going to be a table showing true positives or false positives etc..
cues.zh: 這個表格會顯示真陽性、偽陽性等結果。

cues.en: Then we're going to compare the different models or versions to select the best one.
cues.zh: 然後比較不同模型或版本，挑選最佳的一個。

cues.en: And now we can move to the model deployment.
cues.zh: 接著就能進入模型部署。

cues.en: So at this stage here the best model is selected and deployed to production.
cues.zh: 在這個階段，會選出最佳模型並部署到正式環境。

cues.en: We're going to choose the highest performing model based on the evaluation metrics that we've just discussed up above.
cues.zh: 我們會依照剛才介紹的評估指標，選擇表現最好的模型。

cues.en: Then that is going to be piped through the model deployer.
cues.zh: 再將它送進模型部署器。

cues.en: This is going to handle the deployment process.
cues.zh: 它負責處理部署流程。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a model registry.
cues.zh: 接著會有模型登錄庫。

cues.en: This is going to be the central repository for storing and versioning our models.
cues.zh: 這是集中儲存模型並管理其版本的儲存庫。

cues.en: And then we're going to have the production deployment which is going to be the process of making the model available for real time inference.
cues.zh: 接著是正式環境部署，讓模型能夠提供即時推論。

cues.en: So you can move to the inference part which is just right up here.
cues.zh: 然後就進入上面這裡的推論部分。

cues.en: So in this part here we're going to infer the model performance and also perform a risk analysis.
cues.zh: 這一部分會進行模型推論與效能判斷，也會執行風險分析。

cues.en: So we're first going to have this new transaction which is going to be the real time transaction data requiring fraud analysis.
cues.zh: 首先是新交易，也就是需要詐欺分析的即時交易資料。

cues.en: Then it's going to be piped through the model inference, where we're going to use the deployed model to make predictions.
cues.zh: 接著送進模型推論，使用已部署的模型進行預測。

cues.en: Then you're going to go through a risk analysis stage, where we're going to analyze the model's output to determine the risk level.
cues.zh: 再進入風險分析階段，分析模型輸出，判定風險程度。

cues.en: Then we're going to assign a risk score which is a numerical score indicating fraud probability.
cues.zh: 接著指派風險分數，以數值表示詐欺機率。

cues.en: Then we're going to flag or clear the transaction.
cues.zh: 然後標記或放行交易。

cues.en: Here our decision is going to be made whether to flag a suspicious transactions or to clear legitimate ones.
cues.zh: 這裡會決定是否標記可疑交易，或放行合法交易。

cues.en: Then as with any machine learning model, we have to have a human involvement.
cues.zh: 和任何機器學習模型一樣，我們必須讓人員參與。

cues.en: So in our case, we're going to also have a human review stage where transactions with high risk scores are going to be flagged for human review.
cues.zh: 因此這個案例也會有人工作業的審查階段，將風險分數高的交易標記為需要人工審查。

cues.en: The human reviewers are going to either confirm or reject the fraud flag providing feedback.
cues.zh: 審查人員會確認或否決詐欺標記，提供回饋。

cues.en: This feedback, along with new data, is going to be used to retrain the models periodically.
cues.zh: 這些回饋會連同新資料，定期用來重新訓練模型。

cues.en: In our case here, the human reviewer is going to be an account executive who is going to be reviewing the flagged transactions.
cues.zh: 在我們的案例中，人工審查人員是客戶經理，負責審查被標記的交易。

cues.en: Then this reviewer can either confirm or reject the fraud.
cues.zh: 這位審查人員可以確認或否決詐欺判定。

cues.en: Then you're going to have a feedback loop where we capture the human decisions for the model improvement, then we can auto retrain our data where we schedule processes to retrain models with the new data.
cues.zh: 接著建立回饋迴路，收集人工決策以改善模型，再透過排程流程，用新資料自動重新訓練模型。

cues.en: And we're also going to be integrating machine learning flow, which is somewhere down here.
cues.zh: 我們也會整合 MLflow，就在下面這裡。

cues.en: And the MLflow is basically an open source platform for managing the end to end machine learning lifecycle.
cues.zh: MLflow 基本上是管理端到端機器學習生命週期的開源平台。

cues.en: In a fraud detection system.
cues.zh: 在詐欺偵測系統中，

cues.en: MLflow is going to integrate with our pipeline to record training parameters, track model performance metrics, store model versions, and manage deployments, therefore creating a complete audit trail
cues.zh: MLflow 會與管線整合，記錄訓練參數、追蹤模型效能指標、儲存模型版本，並管理部署，藉此建立完整的稽核軌跡，

cues.en: for the machine learning process while simplifying the model management.
cues.zh: 涵蓋機器學習流程，同時簡化模型管理。

cues.en: Our MLflow is going to have an MLflow tracking server, which is going to be the tool for experiment tracking, model versioning and deployment, and it's going to connect to the various pipeline components
cues.zh: MLflow 會有一個追蹤伺服器，用於實驗追蹤、模型版本管理與部署，並連接管線中的各個元件，

cues.en: to log metrics, parameters and artifacts.
cues.zh: 記錄指標、參數與產出檔。

cues.en: And that's basically it for our machine learning flow.
cues.zh: 這基本上就是我們的機器學習流程。

cues.en: I hope it makes sense.
cues.zh: 希望這樣說明很清楚。

cues.en: If not, don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果還不清楚，也別擔心。

cues.en: We're going to be working on this step by step as we build our API.
cues.zh: 建立 API 時，我們會一步一步完成。

cues.en: And that's it for the machine learning pipeline architecture.
cues.zh: 機器學習管線架構就介紹到這裡。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next lecture.
cues.zh: 下一堂課見。
